text: the app seems to work ok and has a nice Colorful layout. the only issues are the reminders seems to be coded like text messages so I get them on all my linked devices displaying texta and calls only and you can't delete any habits. two very annoying features that will cause me to stop using the pap quite quickly.
author: Nina Tryggvadottir
developer_reply: Hello. We are sorry for your negative experience. Providing all our users with a good experience is our priority. We would appreciate it if you could contact us at hi@appdearme.com and let our team know about the issue you're having in more detail. You can also delete the habits by swiping left 😊
